# The felt of holes 7-9, generated by make_course.py from course.py (do not edit).
new
material new Felt --base-color 0.1686 0.8588 0.4471 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.6549 0.9608 0.2784 --no-slot
material new Tee --base-color 1.0000 0.6706 0.4824 --no-slot
# hole 7: BUMPER GARDEN
add mesh grid --name Green7 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 56 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 5.6000 1
apply --scale
translate -12.0000 -8.4000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.08 * clamp((pos.x - (-7.1)) / (-9.799999999999999), 0, 1) * 1 + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (-8.5)) * (pos.x - (-8.5)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (7.0)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (7.0))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -16.900 && pos.x < -7.100 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.600 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.200)) || ((pos.x - -8.5) * (pos.x - -8.5) + ((0 - pos.y) - 7.0) * ((0 - pos.y) - 7.0) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - -16.1) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 10.4) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
# hole 8: DOGLEG BANK
add mesh grid --name Green8 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 62 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 6.2000 1
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 -8.3000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.14 * 1 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (5.2)) / (6.2), 0, 1) + -0.08 * 1 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (8.8)) / (2.5999999999999996), 0, 1) + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (3.25)) * (pos.x - (3.25)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (6.4)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (6.4))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -4.900 && pos.x < 4.900 && (0 - pos.y) > 8.800 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.400) || (pos.x > 1.600 && pos.x < 4.900 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.200 && (0 - pos.y) < 8.800)) || ((pos.x - 3.25) * (pos.x - 3.25) + ((0 - pos.y) - 6.4) * ((0 - pos.y) - 6.4) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - -4.1) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 10.1) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
# hole 9: SKY SUMMIT
add mesh grid --name Green9 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 60 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 6.0000 1
apply --scale
translate 12.0000 -8.4000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.3 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (14.3)) * (pos.x - (14.3)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (7.9)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (7.9))) / 2.0000) + -0.07 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (14.3)) * (pos.x - (14.3)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (7.9)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (7.9))) / 0.3528))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > 7.100 && pos.x < 16.900 && (0 - pos.y) > 5.400 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.400)) || (pos.x > 14.200 && pos.x < 16.900 && (0 - pos.y) > 10.100 && (0 - pos.y) < 11.400) || ((pos.x - 14.3) * (pos.x - 14.3) + ((0 - pos.y) - 7.9) * ((0 - pos.y) - 7.9) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - 7.9) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 10.600000000000001) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
export greens3.glb
